description: Record this principal's yes to raise Space maturity one step (line to log, or log to articles). Raising the level is one yes per principal. Sibling seats count once. Every active principal must yes before the Space upgrades. No downgrade. Upgrade to articles writes the first register entry, ratified by every principal who yes'd. Already articles is 409. Requires an explicit human yes. Do not invent a yes. Side effect: records the yes and may set space.maturity_level. REST POST /v1/maturity/yes. Needs write scope. Not idempotent.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A string you generate once per intended action (a UUID is good) and repeat on retry. A retry with the same key and arguments returns the first result instead of acting twice; the same key with different arguments is refused. Kept 24 hours.

name: maturity_yes
title: Maturity yes
